preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10**5 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases has a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == '-1' or (len(result[i].split()) == len(test_cases[i]) and all(int(p) >= 1 and int(p) <= len(test_cases[i]) for p in result[i].split())) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' or a space-separated list of integers representing a valid permutation of the string's indices.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == '-1' or is_palindrome(apply_permutation(test_cases[i], [int(p) for p in result[i].split()])) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', applying the permutation to the string results in a palindromic string.
